comparison.objective: Choose a height-matched stay, install it in a collar, and seat a wing between rails with its tip supported level.
comparison.physical_skill: Part selection, insertion, guided seating, and two-support alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Correct stay installed; wing root against the stop and tip level on the stay; numeric tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Support selection and guided wing placement test different mechanics and outcomes from notch fracture and tang recovery.
